IM-Board frontend third-party license texts

All package-lock v3 non-dev nodes are conservative frontend dependency candidates, including types and peer dependencies. This is not the Vite linked module graph or a license compatibility determination. Build-only dev nodes, Rust, CLI, models and Python are outside this inventory.
Registry integrity values below are taken from package-lock; installed package bytes are fingerprinted separately. Collection does not download or authenticate registry tarballs. Full terms are detected structurally; this is not a legal review. All declared alternatives and discovered internal LICENSE/NOTICE files are preserved.

========================================================================
